thread:
Maria: Quick question — can the console show an "estimated notify fanout" in the SLO/alert rule editor? I want to know roughly how many contacts will be reached before we commit a rule.
Sam: Short answer: yes, but it's tricky. We can approximate from contact mappings + tenant overrides. Exact fanout depends on dedupe and escalation.
Alex: We could add an API field like `fanout_preview` which returns an estimate + breakdown (email/sms/pager). But we need privacy checks — don't leak contact identifiers.
Maria: Right, just counts/tiers, not emails/numbers. UI should show something like "~42 contacts (primary 30, oncall 12)".
Sam: Also needs to account for notify quotas and per-tenant rate limits. If tenant has quota throttle, preview should reflect that.
Jim: How would the API compute this without calling the notify pipeline? We don't want heavy calls in the editor.
Alex: We can compute from cached mapping tables and short-circuit dedupe heuristics. Something like: `{"estimate": 42, "dedupe_factor": 0.75, "quota_applied": false}` — lightweight and fast.
Olivia: Telemetry question: if preview exposes estimates, do we record every preview event? That could blow up telemetry.
Sam: Good call. Make preview telemetry sampled (1%) and aggregate metrics: preview_count, avg_estimate, preview_errors.
Maria: UX: show a small info icon: "estimate doesn't guarantee notifications — final delivery may differ due to quotas and dedupe."
Alex: API param `?preview=true&include_quota=true` could let console opt-in to more accurate estimate (may be slightly slower). Default remains fast estimate.
Jim: Security: console can only preview for rules the user can manage. No cross-tenant previews. Enforce in API layer.
Olivia: Also add an ACL log event so auditors can see who previewed fanouts (not the actual contacts).
Sam: Implementation plan: 1) add fanout_preview to rule-preview endpoint (fast path). 2) a heavier path behind `include_quota` that consults quota service. 3) sample telemetry and a feature flag.
Maria: Sounds good. Can someone mock a UI microcopy and wireframe? I can take a quick mock.
Alex: I'll draft the API contract and privacy checklist — will post a PR with example responses.
Jim: I'll sketch perf constraints (max 200ms for fast path). If heavy path >500ms mark as async and show "estimate pending" in UI.
Olivia: Creating a tiny RFC and a rollout checklist: telemetry sampling, privacy review, feature flag gating.
Maria: Cool — thanks. @Sam can you add the design + API tasks to the SLO project board?
Sam: Yup, added. Card: "fanout_preview in alert rule editor". ETA for prototype: next sprint. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder: put any schema changes in the API changelog folder and add migration notes if we persist preview caches.
Maria: Agree. We'll keep this behind a feature flag and opt-in on the console side for the first release.
Alex: I'll ping infra about a small cache for mapping tables to keep fast path under 200ms.
Maria: Thanks all — moving to action items.
